name: EconomyBookings
description:
EconomyBookings helps travelers easily search and compare
rental cars worldwide. Find available vehicles by pickup location,
travel dates, driver age, and preferences like car category,
transmission type, supplier, model, and total rental price, all
through natural conversation.

Results include trusted rental suppliers, transparent pricing, and
key rental terms to help you compare options confidently before
booking.

_published_faq.name: How do I add EconomyBookings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add EconomyBookings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.economybookings.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the EconomyBookings MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: EconomyBookings provides these MCP tools: search-car-hire.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to EconomyBookings?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to EconomyBookings in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
EconomyBookings does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
EconomyBookings is developed by Economy Bookings. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
